explanation: This is 0 everywhere except at D2 of late-episode trials (about trial 93 onward) where the agent chose a1 and commonly reached S1 after at least one earlier a1-to-S1 trial; there it climbs with the trial number and the run of consecutive a1-to-S1 trials, roughly 3-6 around trials 93-95, 8-9 at trials 96-98 and 9-10 at trial 99. Any a2 choice, any rare transition, the first a1-to-S1 trial right after one of those (0-2), every D1 and GO step, and all trials before about 92 are 0.
